title: feat(ingest-rules): ship to every org, drop the rollout flags

summaries.body:
<!-- maple-pr-review 9585bfc4-0173-44df-88c9-bc20c594133a 0 -->
## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
Flag removal is consistent across domain, backend, web and tests, with no dangling references and the gateway path already indexed and metered.
<sub>no findings · tests covered · risk medium</sub>

Drops both ingest-rules gates: the prd deploy no longer forces `INGEST_RULES_ENABLED=false`, and the per-org Clerk flag, its 403 error and the web gating are removed. Nothing is left dangling at the head; safe to merge.

- Ingest gateway task takes `INGEST_RULES_ENABLED` from the deploy env only, so the binary's on default applies
- `IngestRulesNotAvailableError` and the `ingestRules` Clerk flag are gone from the domain and v2 contract
- `IngestRuleService` no longer reads feature flags; writes are gated by admin only
- The Ingestion tab always fetches and shows the rules section

### Before merge

- [ ] **Infra** · Check every environment has what this config now expects · [`apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/af50a9e6bb3ecdfc10a07816776cac9771899056/apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts) <!-- ms:infra:apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts -->
- [ ] **Manual** · Confirm no `INGEST_RULES_ENABLED=false` lingers in the prd and dev deploy environments, or the new default never applies <!-- ms:manual:confirm-no-ingest-rules-enabled-false-lingers-in-the-prd-and-dev-deploy-b8d9eb56 -->

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- Gateway default is on and reads the kill switch: `apps/ingest/src/main.rs:589`
- Rule lookups hit `org_ingest_rules_org_idx` and count in `ingest_rules_fetch_failed_total` (`metrics.rs:151`)
- No `IngestRulesNotAvailable`, `ingest_rules_not_available` or `hasIngestRules` remains anywhere at the head

</details>

<sub>`af50a9e` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.</sub>
